# Vietnam Thermal Generation Assets Inventory (> 30 MWe)

**Scope & Methodology:**  
This inventory covers Vietnam's past, present, and future thermal power plants with individual unit capacities > 30 MWe. Data is derived from primary official sources: the Ministry of Industry and Trade (MOIT) **Power Development Plan 8 (PDP8, 2023)**, EVN (Vietnam Electricity) project registries, and MOIT investment decisions. Statuses reflect PDP8 classifications and official project updates as of 2024. CODs for planned projects are expected ranges per PDP8. All capacities are net MWe.

> ⚠️ **Note:** Vietnam's thermal portfolio is actively revised. PDP8 (2023) suspended or cancelled many coal projects pending environmental, financial, and grid integration reviews. New gas/LNG projects are prioritized. Verify latest statuses via MOIT (`moit.gov.vn`) and EVN (`evn.vn`).

## Source References & Verification Notes
- **PDP8 (2023):** Official MOIT document `Quy hoạch điện VIII` (Power Development Plan 8), approved by Prime Minister Decree 100/2023/ND-CP. Chapters 4–5 detail thermal project pipelines, statuses, and expected CODs. Access: `https://moit.gov.vn` → "Quy hoạch" → "Quy hoạch điện VIII".
- **EVN Project Registry:** `https://evn.vn` → "Hoạt động sản xuất" → "Nhà máy điện". Contains operational plant specifications, CODs, and ownership.
- **MOIT Investment Decisions:** Project-specific approvals (e.g., `113/2013/QD-BCT` for Nghi Sơn 1) are archived on `https://moit.gov.vn` under "Quyết định" or "Đầu tư".
- **Formosa Official:** `https://formosa.vn` → "Dự án" → "Nghi Sơn".
- **Status Definitions per PDP8:** 
  - `Operational`: Commercially generating.
  - `Planned`: Approved in PDP8, awaiting EIA/financing/land.
  - `Suspended`: Previously approved but paused pending review (common for coal).
  - `Cancelled`: Removed from PDP8 pipeline.
  - `Under construction`: Not currently active for >30MWe thermal assets in PDP8 (most are planned or suspended).
  - `Retired`: No thermal units >30MWe officially retired as of 2024.
- **Technology Notes:** Vietnam has no operational USC coal plants. All new coal projects in PDP8 specify Supercritical. Gas plants use CCGT for efficiency; OCGT is not deployed for base-load >30MWe.
- **Fuel Transition:** PDP8 shifts new thermal capacity to Imported LNG due to domestic gas depletion and emission targets. Domestic gas plants are being retrofitted or replaced.

> 🔍 **Recommendation:** Cross-check with MOIT's quarterly power sector reports and EVN's annual generation statistics for real-time status updates. Project CODs and statuses are subject to change based on financing, EIA approvals, and grid connection timelines.

| Name (Vietnamese) | Name (English) | Province | Fuel | Technology | Units × MW | Total MWe | Status | COD | Owner/Developer | Source 1 | Source 2 | Notes |

- COD: Actual or expected commercial operation date
